about_the_game:
Enter the world of Bililitz, a vertical roguelike set in a mysterious realm shaped by magic and secrets. Each playthrough challenges you to hone your ever-changing skills, where every step is unpredictable and danger lurks around every corner. The world itself transforms with procedural generation, ensuring that no two journeys are the same.

As you ascend, you'll discover hidden treasures, powerful items, and enchanted portals that connect to new and dangerous worlds. The deeper you delve, the more mysteries you uncover—about the land, its ancient magic, and the true power lurking at the heart of Bililitz.

But you won't be exploring alone—your skills will be tested against others in the global ranking system. Compete for the highest score, survive the longest, and prove your worth among the best adventurers.

Key Features:

🌌 Procedurally Generated Worlds—No two playthroughs are the same; each ascent offers new surprises and challenges.

⚔️ Fast-Paced Roguelike Action – Face enemies, traps, and ever-changing environments that demand skill and adaptability.

🗝️ Mysteries and Secrets – Discover magical relics, hidden paths, and stories scattered throughout each realm.

🔮 Powerful Items and Portals – Collect upgrades and unlock portals to entirely new worlds.

🏆 Global Ranking System – Compete with players worldwide and reach the top of the leaderboards.

♾️ Endless Replayability – Each run is a new adventure filled with danger and discovery.

Prepare for a magical ascent where knowledge, skill, and bravery define your destiny. The world of Bililitz awaits—will you uncover its deepest secrets?
